proof_skeleton_nl: First decompose n*r into its integer part m and fractional remainder theta, then rewrite r as m/n + theta/n with theta/n in [0,1/n). Next verify that m is a legal cell index and invoke the shifted monotonicity of the translated function u -> f_n(m/n + u) on [0,1/n). Finally apply the generic comparison lemma at u = theta/n and at 0 to obtain f_n(r) <= f_n(m/n), exactly the required inequality.
